breakdown.description: Tip boundary condition is inconsistent: an adiabatic tip implies zero heat flux at the tip, so a convective-tip model should not be used.
breakdown.reason: The user's prompt was contradictory, stating the fin has an adiabatic tip but then asking to use a convective-tip formula. The ground truth resolves this by clarifying that the adiabatic-tip solution should be used. The agent failed to resolve this; instead of using the adiabatic-tip solution, it used a corrected-length formula which is an approximation for a convective tip. This follows the incorrect part of the user's prompt and contradicts the ground truth's resolution.
